name: Care Of Your Animal
overview: Scripture teaches that God has entrusted mankind with dominion over animals, calling us to exercise responsible stewardship and care for them. A righteous person values the life of their animals and diligently attends to their well-being, as seen in the exhortation to know the condition of one’s flocks and herds. Furthermore, God’s providential care for birds reminds us that He sustains all creatures, and by extension, we are called to reflect His compassion and provision in how we care for our animals. This stewardship is part of living out the image of God, who lovingly governs all creation.
